cards.headline: Port St. Lucie man arrested under hotel bed faces meth, child neglect charges
cards.teaser: Kenneth Robert Ferow II, wanted on a Martin County battery warrant, was arrested at a Village Parkway hotel where police found him hiding under a bed with methamphetamine and two children in the room.
cards.body: Port St. Lucie police arrested Kenneth Robert Ferow II on methamphetamine possession and child neglect charges after finding the 41-year-old hiding under a bed at a Village Parkway hotel where he was wanted on a Martin County simple battery warrant. Officers discovered two children, ages 14 and 8, inside the hotel room.

cards.headline: Fort Pierce brothers killed in Georgia shooting; 18-year-old arrested after altercation
cards.teaser: The Fort Pierce community is raising money to bring home two brothers, ages 11 and 12, who were shot and killed Sunday in DeKalb County, Georgia. Police arrested an 18-year-old suspect and said the shooting stemmed from an altercation that began during a backyard football game days earlier.
cards.body: The Fort Pierce community is raising money to bring home two brothers who were shot and killed Sunday at an apartment complex in DeKalb County, Georgia. hero.headline: 17 businesses raise over $10,000 for Sebastian River High play clocks after coach's Facebook post
hero.teaser: Seventeen local businesses raised more than $10,000 for new play clocks at Sebastian River High School after coach Phinehas Weatherly posted about equipment problems on Facebook.
hero.body:
Seventeen local businesses raised more than $10,000 for new play clocks at Sebastian River High School after coach Phinehas Weatherly posted about equipment problems on Facebook.

 Weatherly said the varsity football program has struggled with malfunctioning play clocks for four years. Each repair cost thousands of dollars.

cards.headline: Vero Beach doubles most parking fines starting Oct. 1, first increase since 2011
cards.teaser: Vero Beach City Council voted Tuesday to double most parking fines starting Oct. 1, the first increase since 2011. Fines for timed parking violations will increase from $20 to $40,
cards.body:
Vero Beach City Council voted Tuesday to double most parking fines starting Oct. 1, the first increase since 2011. Fines for timed parking violations will increase from $20 to $40, while other miscellaneous infractions will rise from $30 to $60. Handicap violations will remain at $200 per violation.

cards.body:
